_comment: Pinned SG13G2 PDK revision and OSDI toolchain every committed evidence record under sim/ was generated against. Plain greppable fact sheet; sim/harness/common/fetch-pdk.sh reads release_url and tarball_sha256 from here. Bumping a pin is a new commit; earlier records stay as they were.

osdi_toolchain._comment: The PDK tarball ships Verilog-A sources, not .osdi binaries. The compiler pins (repo, tag, per-platform asset sha256, libllvm21 deb) live only in sim/harness/common/build-osdi.sh, vendored from the sibling (see reuse.lock.json); read them with `sim/harness/common/build-osdi.sh --print-pins`. sim/pdk-smoke/run_smoke.sh does so for its record. No .osdi is committed; they are rebuilt locally.
osdi_toolchain.approach: compile the PDK's own Verilog-A with a checksum-pinned OpenVAF-Reloaded
